name: cursor-supervisor
description: Run the Telegram ↔ Cursor ACP bridge from the IDE: start, stop, and monitor the local service.

cursorSupervisor.enabled.description: Enable Cursor Supervisor. When off, the extension will not start the service (Start and autoStart are blocked). Disabling while the Telegram integration is running shows a confirmation to stop it.
cursorSupervisor.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable Cursor Supervisor. When off, **Start** and **autoStart** are blocked. Disabling while the Telegram integration is running asks to stop the service.

API keys are stored in `config.json` (not in Settings) so they stay masked:
- [Set Telegram bot token](command:cursorSupervisor.setTelegramBotToken)
- [Set Cursor API key](command:cursorSupervisor.setCursorApiKey)

cursorSupervisor.autoStart.description: Start Cursor Supervisor automatically when the workspace opens (if enabled, config.json exists, and the service is not running).

cursorSupervisor.configPath.description: Path to config.json passed to the CLI.
cursorSupervisor.configPath.markdownDescription:
Path to `config.json` passed to the CLI. Default is the **user-global** file `~/.cursor-supervisor/config.json` (shared with the CLI). Secrets live in this file.

- [Set Telegram bot token](command:cursorSupervisor.setTelegramBotToken)
- [Set Cursor API key](command:cursorSupervisor.setCursorApiKey)

cursorSupervisor.nodePath.description: Node.js executable used to run the bundled service.

cursorSupervisor.executablePath.description: Override path to the Cursor Supervisor executable. Leave empty for auto-detection (bundled server, workspace, or PATH).

cursorSupervisor.detach.description: Run as a detached subprocess so it keeps running when the IDE closes.

cursorSupervisor.statusPollIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh the status bar (milliseconds).
